title: Our 2025 poverty prediction, graded
subject: Pre-registered 2025 Supplemental Poverty Measure poverty forecasts for all people, children under 18 and people age 65+, graded against Census; includes the prior model, model and survey threshold/resource decomposition, raw-survey aging, senior-deduction counterfactual and income-uprating sensitivity diagnostics.

current_law.description: 2025 federal current law, as modeled for the registered prediction and diagnostics; model and anchoring variants are named in each estimate.

legacy_model.description: Current law as modeled by the then-production policyengine-us 1.764.6 with CPI-aged 2025 thresholds.

survey_diagnostic.description: Public-use CPS ASEC diagnostic with observed 2025 thresholds and reported resources, including counterfactual threshold or composition calculations.

raw_uniform_growth.description: Diagnostic aging the calendar-2024 raw survey to 2025 BLS thresholds and uniformly raising SPM resources by the model near-line median (4.61%); this was calculated after the Census release.

senior_deduction_removed.description: 2025 law except the enhanced senior deduction amount is zero.

ss_cola_pension_cpi.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Social Security grows with the modeled COLA, pensions and retirement distributions with January-over-January CPI-U.

se_like_wages.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Self-employment income grows with wages.

all_three.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Social Security at the COLA, pensions at January-over-January CPI-U, and self-employment grown with wages.

all_three_ss_66plus.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Social Security at the age-adjusted survey rate for recipients age 66+, pensions at annual-average CPI-U, and self-employment grown with wages.

wages_by_decile.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Wages grow by the survey mean-wage growth within wage deciles.

wages_by_family_decile.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Wages grow by the survey mean-wage growth within deciles of SPM resources relative to threshold.

all_four.description: Sensitivity run on current law. Social Security at the COLA, pensions at annual-average CPI-U, self-employment with wages, and wages by survey deciles of family resources.
